LanguageData.STQ.Warden.Intro.Title: Guardian Protocols
LanguageData.STQ.Warden.Intro.Text: Sensors indicate a dormant guardian lattice. Stabilize the subspace lock to negotiate access. — April
LanguageData.STQ.Warden.StartOrder.Title: Initialize the Trial
LanguageData.STQ.Warden.StartOrder.Text: Use the relay to begin. Keep it powered until completion.
LanguageData.STQ.Warden.Mid.Title: Resonance Rising
LanguageData.STQ.Warden.Mid.Text: Telemetry shows guardian responses. Perimeter discipline.
LanguageData.STQ.Warden.Success.Title: Lock Stabilized
LanguageData.STQ.Warden.Success.Text: Excellent work. The lattice accepts our credentials. Prepare for access. — April
LanguageData.STQ.Warden.Fail.Title: Sequence Broken
LanguageData.STQ.Warden.Fail.Text: The relay went offline before completion. We’ll reattempt after repairs.
